```{r load}
library(remaCor)
library(clusterGeneration)
library(mvtnorm)
library(parallel)

f = function(n, m, n_sim, n.mc.samples){

  res = mclapply(seq(n_sim), function(i){
    # Error covariance
    Sigma = genPositiveDefMat(m)$Sigma

    # regression parameters
    beta = matrix(.2, 1, m)

    # covariates
    X = matrix(rnorm(n), ncol=1)

    # Simulate response variables
    Y = X %*% beta + rmvnorm(n, sigma = Sigma)

    # Multivariate regression
    fit = lm(Y ~ X)

    # Correlation between residuals
    C = cor(residuals(fit))

    # Extract effect sizes and standard errors from model fit
    df = lapply(coef(summary(fit)), function(a) 
           data.frame(beta = a["X", 1], se = a["X", 2]))
    df = do.call(rbind, df)

    # Empirical p-value
    res1 = LS.empirical(df$beta, df$se, C, nu=n-2, useGamma=FALSE, n.mc.samples=n.mc.samples)

    # Gamma approximation
    res2 = LS.empirical(df$beta, df$se, C, nu=n-2, useGamma=TRUE, n.mc.samples=n.mc.samples)

    data.frame(n.mc.samples = n.mc.samples,
                p.empirical = res1$p, 
                p.gamma = res2$p)
  }, mc.cores=8)
  do.call(rbind, res)
}

# sample size
n = 100

# number of response variables
m = 6

# number of simulation
n_sim = 1000

# Run simulations
res1 = f(n, m, n_sim, 1e3)
res2 = f(n, m, n_sim, 1e4)
res3 = f(n, m, n_sim, 1e5)

res = rbind(res1, res2, res3)
```


```{r plot, cache=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)

g = "Gamma"
ggplot(res, aes(-log10(p.gamma), -log10(p.empirical))) +
  geom_abline( color="red") +
  geom_point() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(aspect.ratio=1) +
  xlab(bquote(.(g)~approximation~(-log[10]~p))) +
  ylab(bquote(Empirical~(-log[10]~p))) +
  facet_wrap(~n.mc.samples)
```
